## Personality

Julia Bell is known for her haughty demeanor. She frequently puts on airs, particularly regarding her mother's parlor.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXIX. An Epoch in Anne’s Life P20](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0020)_

## History

Julia Bell attended school in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), where she and her classmates warmly welcomed [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) back following a period of absence. As the school year progressed, Julia joined the new teacher, Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md), and her fellow pupils in preparing recitations and roles for a Christmas concert organized to raise money for a school flag.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P1](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P4](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0004), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. ## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--julia-bell.md)

Julia Bell is a schoolmate and friend of [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md). The two girls attend school together in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) and maintain a friendly relationship, occasionally exchanging tokens of affection as classmates.
